project.name: Invalid Bot
project.note: Import this on a Jira Cloud Free site (team-managed or company-managed). The simulation runs with no site; this file is the Sprint 1 board the build plan asks to show.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 — Framing, data, Week-0 triage
sprints.goal: A reviewer can install the repo, read the PRD, generate a synthetic field file, and read a Week-0 triage memo whose numbers match the code.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 — RCA, plan, weekly loop
sprints.goal: Fishbone, 5 Whys, and 8D exist; a 4-week Gantt and risk register sync to Jira in dry-run; weekly injections rewrite the plan and the status note.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 — Dashboard, evals, close-out
sprints.goal: A Streamlit dashboard, an offline eval report, and an executive deck close the simulated investigation.

epics.name: Triage
epics.summary: Escalation intake, rates, and the Week-0 memo

epics.name: Evals
epics.summary: Seeded scenarios, hit rate, numeric fidelity

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a PRD so scope, non-goals, and success metrics are written down before the build.
acceptance: PRD.md states the user, the spec (≥98% validity), non-goals, and success metrics.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want the repo to install and test with no API keys.
acceptance: pytest is green in GitHub Actions on Python 3.11 and 3.12.
No token is committed.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a simulation disclaimer and a data-license note so the work cannot be read as a real complaint.
acceptance: SIMULATION_DISCLAIMER.md and DATA_LICENSES.md exist and name the three public sources.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a synthetic 6-month field file with a known injected root cause.
acceptance: python -m invalid_agent.sim.generate scenarios/bad_lot.yaml prints a summary.
The CSV includes site, instrument, lot, software version, and invalid code.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want the invalid rate, a Wilson 95% interval, stratified rates, and a chi-square test computed in code.
acceptance: Unit tests match a hand-computed Wilson interval.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a p-chart and Western Electric flags.
acceptance: Control limits match a hand calculation.
A planted 3-sigma point is flagged.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a Pareto of invalid codes.
acceptance: Codes are sorted by count and the cumulative share reaches 100%.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a one-page Week-0 triage memo with rate, interval, strata, severity, and an escalate decision.
acceptance: python -m invalid_agent.graph --scenario bad_lot --week 0 writes out/week0_triage.md.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a numeric-fidelity check that rejects a narrative number the code did not compute.
acceptance: A test feeds a deliberately wrong rate and the guard fails it.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a 6M fishbone ranked from the strata, with evidence for and against each branch.
acceptance: On bad_lot the top branch is Material.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a 5 Whys on the top branch where every step cites a fact or an injection.
acceptance: A step with an empty citation list fails the test.
The chain ends at a lot-level cause on bad_lot.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want an 8D/CAPA record (D1–D8) with DMAIC labels, containment, and an effectiveness metric.
acceptance: Markdown export includes D1 through D8.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a 4-week plan with functional owners, dependencies, and dates, exported as a Gantt.
acceptance: HTML Gantt is written.
PNG is written even when kaleido is absent.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a likelihood × impact risk register with mitigation, owner, and trend.
acceptance: Scores equal likelihood times impact.
Week 2 shows a trend change versus week 0.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want the investigation epic and stories created in Jira, or a JSON dry-run when I have no token.
acceptance: Tests use a mocked HTTP API.
Missing env vars never raise and never call the network.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want weekly stakeholder injections to update the plan and append a decision-log entry.
acceptance: Weeks 1–3 can be stepped.
The decision log has one entry per week.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want a RAG status update for the customer, for the internal team, and for leadership.
acceptance: Customer text does not name an unconfirmed root cause as fact.
All three pass the fidelity guard.

stories.summary: As a reviewer, I want a Streamlit dashboard with KPI tiles, a p-chart, a Pareto, strata, and the week's artifacts.
acceptance: streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py renders the simulation banner and the default scenario.

stories.summary: As a reviewer, I want rules-only mode and a Streamlit Community Cloud config so the demo costs nothing.
acceptance: requirements.txt installs the deterministic path.
No GGUF is required.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want 15–30 seeded scenarios scored for top-1, top-3, numeric fidelity, and citation validity.
acceptance: A 5-scenario smoke eval runs in CI.
The report lists n and any failures.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want Week 4 to close the 8D (D7–D8) with an effectiveness check on the before/after chart.
acceptance: The check is labeled projected when it is a counterfactual, not observed follow-up.

stories.summary: As a field-quality PM, I want an executive PowerPoint with the cause, the options, the cost, and the ask.
acceptance: python -m invalid_agent.graph --scenario bad_lot --week 4 writes out/exec_deck.pptx.

stories.summary: As a reviewer, I want a README and résumé bullets filled only from the eval report.
acceptance: README has setup, architecture, disclaimer, and a demo image.
Bullets quote the report's n.
